title: Introduce assertion-based edge RBAC guard, KMS usage metering, and residency retention controls
author: Maya Chen
description:
Context: Customers are asking for stronger enforcement points at the API edge for RBAC v2 and transparent KMS usage accounting to satisfy audits. This change introduces an assertion-driven RBAC guard at the gateway layer, a lightweight KMS usage metering hook (for per-tenant metering and billing accuracy), and a configurable data-residency retention policy enforcement that writes immutable residency tags into audit envelopes. Motivation: 1) Prevent lateral escalation caused by stale service principal claims reaching backend services; 2) Provide cryptographically-signed usage records for KMS operations so compliance teams can reconcile key usage against contracts; 3) Ensure retention/residency controls are recorded in the audit stream and enforced by the private installer and hosted control plane.

What this PR does (high level): - Adds an assertion-based RBAC guard that evaluates token attributes and request labels at the edge; guard can drop, rewrite, or inject tenancy and residency assertions before requests reach the control plane. - Adds a KMS usage metering shim that records per-request key usage (encrypted but signed), compatible with multi-provider KMS setups. Metering supports an allowlist and sampling rate to control volume. - Adds audit envelope enrichment that attaches immutable residency and retention tags, plus a compact provenance signature so downstream auditors can verify origin and geographic assertions. - Introduces a small policy config schema (residency_retention.yaml) and a migration to translate older tenancy-scoped KMS config into the new assertion model. - Adds e2e integration tests and docs for operators on rollout steps and escalation procedures.

Backwards compatibility & rollout: The new edge guard runs behind a feature-flag (feature.edge_assertion_rbac) and defaults to "observe" mode (it logs decisions but does not block). The KMS-metering shim defaults to disabled; operators can enable sampling and the allowlist. The residency tagger has an "enforce" flag for air-gapped/private installs; hosted deployments will be opt-in during initial rollout. See docs for migration steps. A gradual rollout plan is part of the Linear ticket list.

Security considerations: - Assertion signing keys are stored in KMS-backed HSMs where available; a rotation plan is included. - The metering records only include key identifiers and cryptographic proof (no plaintext customer data). - RBAC rules are evaluated in a sandboxed engine to avoid policy injection risks.

Operational notes: - Dashboard panels added to the Console to surface KMS metering counters and edge rejection rates. - Default alert: spike in rejection rate or KMS-metering errors (>1% of requests) triggers on-call.

References: Linear ENG-8921 (edge assertion rbac workstream), PM-341 (compliance requirements), SUP-1245 (customer request).
commits: 3 commits: 1) edge: add assertion-based RBAC guard and tests; 2) kms: add usage metering shim + signatures; 3) audit: add residency envelope enrichment and docs + migration scripts
review_comments:
Rafael Torres: Requested changes - please split the large enforcer.go into smaller strategy files and add more unit tests around assertion expiry and replay protection. Also flagged a potential TODO: how do we handle legacy tokens without residency claims?

Maya Chen (author): Replied - split enforcer into strategy/mapper/instrumentation files and added unit tests for expiry and nonce-based replay detection; added a compatibility mapper that synthesizes residency claims from tenant metadata when feature.flag == 'compat'.

Priya Nambiar: Asked for clear docs for operators about key rotation and a sample incident runbook.

Maya Chen: Added rotation.md and incident runbook to docs/compliance and updated the rollout section.

Evan Brooks: Quick security pass and approved after small nits fixed (comments inline).

CI: initial lint failed on go vet in pkg/audit/enricher; fixed and re-ran. Integration tests pass on linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 by second run.
merge_outcome: merged (squash-merge) by Priya Nambiar after approvals; merge commit includes condensed changelog and references ENG-8921, PM-341; deployed to staging per rollout playbook
release_notes:
- New: Edge assertion-based RBAC guard (observe mode) with operator toggle
- New: KMS usage metering shim for signed per-request key usage accounting (opt-in)
- New: Audit envelope residency and retention tags with provenance signature
- Migration: residency_retention policy schema and converter
Operators: follow docs/compliance/kms-region-metering.md for enabling and rollout steps.
